name: Spain (Second Republic, 1931–1939)

colors.symbolism: the murrey of Castile, added to mark the new republic

description: A horizontal tricolor of red, yellow and murrey (purple), the republican arms at the centre.
history: Flag of the Second Spanish Republic (1931–1939), which replaced the red-yellow-red bicolor with a murrey third stripe for Castile. Abolished by Franco; it remains the banner of Spanish republicanism.

features.role: arms of the Spanish Republic with mural crown
